item.question: How does heterogeneity in microbial infectivity affect infection probability?
item.answer: Heterogeneity in microbial infectivity can enhance the chances of infection when there is variation within the microbial population ingested by a host. This type of heterogeneity increases the likelihood of infection compared to scenarios where infectivity is uniform.
